summary: Round 11 storefront E2E PASS. Verified (1) 套餐限时+库存 on Home: combo card shows 立省/countdown/仅剩 N 份, 立即抢购 adds to cart and renders checkout-combo-discount; (2) 抽奖分享得次数 on /lottery: POST /api/lottery/share grants bonus draw, 2nd click same day returns '今日分享奖励已领取' toast, free badge switches from 今日有 1 次免费 → 你有 1 次分享免费; (3) lottery single+batch buttons still present (points=5000, free daily available). Admin pages (活动数据看板, 首页装修) SKIPPED per request (admin 2FA).

feature_test_results.combo_card_countdown: PASS — countdown '02:58:49' present inside combo-card (end time active).
feature_test_results.combo_buy_to_checkout: PASS — [data-testid=combo-buy-7f7eb86527ad] (text=立即抢购) adds 2 cart items (cart-item-combo_7f7eb86527ad__15680__15680-218590 for 火兔直播 50万金币, cart-item-combo_7f7eb86527ad__15707__15707-218884 for 天狗直播 5000狗钻) and navigates to /checkout.
feature_test_results.checkout_combo_discount_row: PASS — [data-testid=checkout-combo-discount] = '超值双人组: -$7.39'. [data-testid=checkout-total] = '$9.79' (= $17.38 − $7.39 combo discount). Did NOT pay the order per instruction.
feature_test_results.lottery_free_badge_pre_share: PASS — [data-testid=lottery-free-badge] = '🎁 今日有 1 次免费抽奖机会！' (daily_free_available=true).
feature_test_results.lottery_share_grant_first_click: PASS — POST /api/lottery/share returned 200, bonus_draw granted (observed in follow-up: free-badge switched to '🎁 你有 1 次分享免费抽奖机会！', and /api/lottery/my-status shows bonus_draws=1).
feature_test_results.lottery_share_second_click_same_day: PASS — POST /api/lottery/share returned 200 with body {granted: false, bonus_draws: 1, message: '今日分享奖励已领取'}, and the sonner toast '今日分享奖励已领取' is visible on screen (captured via [data-sonner-toast] selector).
feature_test_results.lottery_single_and_batch_buttons: PASS — [data-testid=lottery-draw-btn-2]='免费抽 1 次' (because daily free is available), [data-testid=lottery-draw-btn-10]='连抽十次（1000 积分）'. Not executed draws this run (previous iteration already confirmed modal + results).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: toast rendered via sonner uses [data-sonner-toast] (not role=status/alert). Not a bug, just an observation for future testing agents using generic toast selectors.

AuthModal: inputs do not have data-testid; relied on placeholders ('信箱 / 手机号 / 帐号', '密码'). Adding data-testid=auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-btn would make the login flow more robust for automated tests.

AuthModal: the agree checkbox is sr-only and clicking the visible span '条款与条件' opens a terms modal (expected) but the whole 已阅读并同意 label is not a label-for element — Playwright had to toggle it via JS click(). Not a bug, works for real users clicking the visible pill.
test_credentials: Member: tester+clerk_test@shop.com / Gogo589!Tester#4m9Z — logged in cleanly, no 2FA email code prompted this session (Clerk device-trust not triggered).
seed_data_creation: None. Used seeded combo id 7f7eb86527ad (超值双人组 = 火兔直播 50万金币 + 天狗直播 5000狗钻, pkg $9.99 vs $17.38 = $7.39 off, stock=20, ~2h58m remaining on end_time). The lottery share grant WAS consumed during this run (first click granted bonus_draws 0→1; subsequent clicks today return '今日分享奖励已领取'). bonus_draws=1 remains on the member — next tester should reset lottery_share state again if re-testing the grant path.
